description: A flattened JWS with protected {"alg":"HS256"} and an empty unprotected "header": {}, MAC correct over "Payload" (HMAC computed with Python hmac/hashlib under the RFC 7515 A.1 key): an empty JWS Unprotected Header adds no parameters, so the JOSE Header is the protected one and the JWS is accepted (RFC 7515 §5.2 step 4, §7.2.1; the T05 behaviour)
